items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Yes, she made it on the same time I did.

ctx.x: I was trying to think, did you make, just a few years ago, a Riverside record when they came here? That's it. That's it. Because we were talking about Lil Armstrong. I interviewed her.
Yes, she made it on the same time I did.
Yes, she had the talking record that she had.
